meta.source: v4: Manifest identity in the frame, readable data (merge of v2 direction and v3 readability)

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The ledger cover: top bar background.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text and the seal on the top bar.

tokens.name: chrome-2
tokens.usage: Inactive tabs and secondary text on the top bar (≥4.5:1 on chrome).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ledger page behind every block (carries a faint paper grain).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Paper laid on the page: tables, cards, panes, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, group rows, inbox group headers, report headers.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of rows, chips, tabs. Never a resting state.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected row, item or worker card, always with the 3px ink bar.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Behind the app (same as surface).

tokens.name: sheet-edge
tokens.usage: Outer border of ledger blocks: counters, the task table, the peek pane, dialogs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text; primary button fill; ledger borders. ≥12:1 on every paper.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sub-lines, descriptions.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, timestamps (≥4.5:1 on every paper in both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button, toast, active chip, section number).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dashed row dividers inside blocks.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, buttons, chips) — ≥3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Waits on you: dots, the needs-you count, stamp ink, hazard band on the needs-you counter.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Red text: ages, needs-you labels.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Background of needs-you badges and the needs-you counter.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Anomaly fill: dots, bars, the anomaly count badge, hazard band.

tokens.name: mustard-deep
tokens.usage: Anomaly text.

tokens.name: mustard-tint
tokens.usage: Background of anomaly badges and worker cards.

tokens.name: on-mustard
tokens.usage: Text on a mustard fill.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Light stripe of the hazard band and the Gantt “chờ bạn” bar.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: In progress: running badges, new-report dots, links, focus.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Background of running badges.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done / review-ready / live.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Background of done badges.

tokens.name: ink-tint
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges and tags.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px + 2px offset.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the drawer.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for everything people read. Sentence case — no uppercase labels.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: SectionHeader, dialog titles, the title in the peek pane.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cần bạn chọn nguồn số liệu cache cho watchdog.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Task titles in tables and lists.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Worker reports, decision text, the user’s own words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, badge text (ink-3 or tone colour).

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono only for identifiers: task IDs, paths, commands, endpoints.

groups.name: Ledger
groups.note: Barlow Condensed is the printed form: only for short words — page and section titles, table headers, big numbers, task IDs, stamps.

styles.name: ledger-id
styles.usage: Task IDs in tables, lanes, lists.

styles.name: ledger-label
styles.usage: Table headers and group rows, uppercase — one or two words only.

spacing.note: A 4px base. 20px exists only for the gap between filter groups.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips and status labels; gap between a value and its sub-line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, between chips, nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, slip body padding (vertical), row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps between tags and slips, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between filter groups only.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a SectionHeader, sheet padding (vertical), modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding (horizontal) on desktop; top margin of the desk.

radius.note: Soft corners on every container; pills for status.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips that are not pills, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, the peek pane.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the drawer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, count badges, filter chips, toggles.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Dots and the FM seal.

shadow.note: Shadows are soft and rare: cards are flat with a border.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow of buttons and the primary action — “raised means clickable”.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and the selected worker card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar when scrolled, toasts, the demo panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the drawer.

borderWidth.note: One hairline everywhere; 2px only for focus and selection.

tokens.name: bw-hair
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, controls.

tokens.name: bw-ledger
tokens.usage: Outer border of ledger blocks (counters, task table, peek pane) and section rules.

tokens.name: bw-strong
tokens.usage: Focus ring, active tab.

tokens.name: bw-bar
tokens.usage: Selection bar.

tokens.name: bw-double
tokens.usage: Stamps and the seal (border-style: double).

layout.note: Fixed measures. Breakpoints: bp-desktop → peek pane beside the board, bp-wide → compact top bar, bp-tablet → nav wraps, counters 3-up, tables become cards, bp-phone → 2-up counters.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the sheet. Wide enough for the board table plus the 380px peek pane.

tokens.name: peek-width
tokens.usage: Peek pane beside the board table (≥ bp-desktop).

tokens.name: modal-max
tokens.usage: Detail modal width.

tokens.name: stub-width
tokens.usage: Tear-off stub of a DecisionSlip.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: At or above: the board shows the peek pane beside the table; below: the peek opens as a drawer.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Below this, worker tags drop to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Below this, sidebar → horizontal tabs, KPIs 2×2, filters collapse behind a toggle.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below this, the manifest table renders each row as a card.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky tab strip on tablet/phone.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Copy-confirmation toast.
